arxiv-1608-02516.title: Higher order mean curvatures of SAC half-lightlike submanifolds of indefinite almost contact manifolds
arxiv-1608-02516.creator: Fortuné Massamba*, Samuel Ssekajja**
arxiv-1608-02516.description: Abstract . We introduce higher order mean curvatures of screen almost conformal (SAC) half-lightlike submanifolds of indefinite almost contact manifolds, admitting a semi-symmetric non-metric connection, and use them to generalize some known results of [ 6 ] . Also, we derive a new set of integration formulae via the divergence of some special vector fields tangent to this submanifold.

arxiv-2106-00688.title: Quantifying the Similarity of Planetary System Architectures
arxiv-2106-00688.creator: D. Bashi, S. Zucker
arxiv-2106-00688.description: Abstract The planetary systems detected so far already exhibit a wide diversity of architectures, and various methods are proposed to study quantitatively this diversity. Straightforward ways to quantify the difference between two systems and more generally, two sets of multiplanetary systems, are useful tools in the study of this diversity.

arxiv-2403-05827.description: Abstract We establish a correspondence between automorphisms and derivations on certain algebras of generalised power series. arxiv-2505-15384.description: Abstract This work aims to study a count response random variable, the number of citations of a research paper, affected by some explanatory variables through a suitable regression model. pmc-13597302.creator: Soyoung Jeon, Eunbi Shin, Jin Woong Ha, Min Jeong Na, Sang Yean Kim, Suk Woo Nam
pmc-13597302.description: Alternative polyadenylation (APA) generates mRNA isoforms with distinct 3′ untranslated regions (3′UTRs), thereby influencing transcript stability and translation. In cancer, 3′UTR shortening can activate oncogenes by escaping microRNA (miRNA)-mediated repression, but its role in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains poorly defined. Here, we profiled mRNA length alterations in multistage human HCC transcriptome datasets and investigated their functional consequences.
